name: 功能富集 (GSEA + ORA)

parameters.steps: GO enrichment -> KEGG pathway -> GSEA (fgsea) -> Visualization

detailed_description:
GSEA/ORA功能富集分析。clusterProfiler/gseapy。GO/KEGG/Reactome/MSigDB

分析步骤:
  - GO enrichment: BP/CC/MF via clusterProfiler
  - KEGG pathway: Pathway enrichment + network
  - GSEA (fgsea): Ranked gene set enrichment
  - Visualization: DotPlot + EnrichMap

触发提示: "对DEG做功能富集分析"
when_to_use: 当你需要 功能富集 (GSEA + ORA) 时触发

proven_params.params: clusterProfiler ORA, GO BP+MF+CC, KEGG, Reactome, Old↑ and Old↓ per celltype, padj<0.05
proven_params.result: 566 enriched terms total (Old↑ 267, Old↓ 299). 10 figures generated. 10 cell types each with up/down enrichment
